basic_details.job_title: SGOU Multimedia Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: Not more than 40 years as on 01/01/2026 with usual relaxation to SC/ST and OBC as per Government of Kerala Rules. Upper age-limit relaxation and reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD shall be applicable only in accordance with the rules/orders of the Government of Kerala in force. Only natives of Kerala shall be eligible for reservation benefits, as per applicable rules.

qualification.details: Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. | Minimum 6 months experience in state-of-the-art tools for 3D Graphic Design, Video editing, Multimedia production, Recordings & post production works.

salary_details.multimedia technician: Rs. 34,180/- per month Consolidated Contract Pay
salary_details.details: The appointment is purely on contract basis for the period specified by the University.

selection_process: Selection shall be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee of the University. Short-listed candidates will be called for a skill test and an interview. Appointment will be subject to verification of original documents and satisfactory antecedents.
how_to_apply: Visit the University recruitment portal at https://sgou.ac.in/.
Fill in all particulars in the online application form.
Upload legible copies of the required certificates and documents in support of age, qualifications, experience, ID Proof and other claims along with the application.
Submit the application online within the prescribed time.
Keep a printout or copy of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates shall satisfy all prescribed eligibility conditions, including age, educational qualifications and experience, on the last date prescribed for submission of applications. Candidates claiming equivalent qualifications shall produce the Equivalency Certificate/Order issued by the competent authority. Experience shall be acquired after obtaining the prescribed qualification and shall be from a recognised institution/organisation. Applications shall be submitted only through the University's online application portal. Incomplete, defective and late applications are liable to be rejected. Furnishing false information, suppression of material facts, or submission of forged/certified certificates or documents shall result in cancellation of candidature/appointment. Canvassing in any form or bringing external influence for securing appointment shall lead to disqualification of the candidate. Renewal/extension, if any, shall depend on the requirements of the University, satisfactory performance and the decision of the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Multimedia Technician Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Multimedia Technician.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Multimedia Technician Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. Minimum 6 months experience in state-of-the-art tools for 3D Graphic Design, Video editing, Multimedia production, Recordings & post production works.

rows.qualification_required: Pass in 10+2 or equivalent, AND Degree in Multimedia/Animation/Graphic Design or equivalent from a recognised University. OR 3 years (6 semester) Diploma in Multimedia/Animation/3D graphics/Graphic design or related areas.In the event of non receipt of eligible applications with the above qualification, candidate possessing the following qualifications will be considered: Diploma/Certificate in Multimedia/ Video Editing/Animation/Graphic Design/Studio Floor Management.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Multimedia Technician Age Limit
content_sections.text: Not more than 40 years as on 01/01/2026 with usual relaxation to SC/ST and OBC as per Government of Kerala Rules. Upper age-limit relaxation and reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD shall be applicable only in accordance with the rules/orders of the Government of Kerala in force. Only natives of Kerala shall be eligible for reservation benefits, as per applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Multimedia Technician Salary
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on contract basis for the period specified by the University.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 34,180/- per month Consolidated Contract Pay

content_sections.heading: SGOU Multimedia Technician Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee of the University. Short-listed candidates will be called for a skill test and an interview. Appointment will be subject to verification of original documents and satisfactory antecedents.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGOU Multimedia Technician
content_sections.text: Visit the University recruitment portal at https://sgou.ac.in/ . Fill in all particulars in the online application form. Upload legible copies of the required certificates and documents in support of age, qualifications, experience, ID Proof and other claims along with the application. Submit the application online within the prescribed time. Keep a printout or copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Multimedia Technician Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates shall satisfy all prescribed eligibility conditions, including age, educational qualifications and experience, on the last date prescribed for submission of applications. Candidates claiming equivalent qualifications shall produce the Equivalency Certificate/Order issued by the competent authority. Experience shall be acquired after obtaining the prescribed qualification and shall be from a recognised institution/organisation. Applications shall be submitted only through the University's online application portal. Incomplete, defective and late applications are liable to be rejected. Furnishing false information, suppression of material facts, or submission of forged/certified certificates or documents shall result in cancellation of candidature/appointment. Canvassing in any form or bringing external influence for securing appointment shall lead to disqualification of the candidate. Renewal/extension, if any, shall depend on the requirements of the University, satisfactory performance and the decision of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. What is SGOU Multimedia Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Sreenarayanaguru Open University has released advertisement number RECN/111/2026 to recruit 2 Multimedia Technicians on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under SGOU Multimedia Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Multimedia Technician post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SGOU Multimedia Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for SGOU Multimedia Technician?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent, and possess a Degree in Multimedia/Animation/Graphic Design or equivalent from a recognised University OR a 3-year Diploma in Multimedia/Animation/3D graphics/Graphic design or related areas.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SGOU Multimedia Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 40 years of age as on 01/01/2026, with usual relaxations to SC/ST and OBC as per Government of Kerala Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for SGOU Multimedia Technician?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated contract pay of Rs. 34,180/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for SGOU Multimedia Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the University recruitment portal at https://sgou.ac.in/ by uploading legible copies of required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SGOU Multimedia Technician?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing candidates followed by a skill test and an interview conducted by a duly constituted Selection Committee.
